digital_officials.bio: Meutya Viada Hafid (born 3 May 1978, Bandung) is an Indonesian former television journalist and Golkar politician who became Minister of Communication and Digital Affairs on 21 October 2024 in President Prabowo Subianto's Red and White Cabinet, the first woman to lead the ministry. A former Metro TV newscaster, she previously served multiple terms in the House of Representatives (DPR), chairing Commission I on defense, foreign affairs and information. As minister she has prioritized child protection online, combating online gambling and illegal lending, and digital-economy value retention.

A long-serving Ministry of Trade official, he was Director General of Foreign Trade from 2022 to 2024 before his elevation to minister. He holds a bachelor's in communication science from Sebelas Maret University, a master's in administrative sciences from the University of Indonesia, and a doctorate from Sahid University. As minister he emphasizes expanding exports through trade agreements and manufacturing competitiveness.

He has acted as Indonesia's chief negotiator in trade talks with the United States, leading discussions on the reciprocal-tariff framework. Previously Minister of Industry (2016-2019) and former chairman of the Golkar Party (2017-2024), he holds a mechanical-engineering degree from Gadjah Mada University and postgraduate business degrees from Monash and Melbourne universities.

digital_officials.bio: Alessio Butti (born 1959) is an Italian politician of Fratelli d'Italia and a longtime senator and deputy who served as the party's head of media and telecommunications. In the Meloni government he holds the digital portfolio as Undersecretary of State to the Presidency of the Council with responsibility for Technological Innovation, inheriting functions of the former standalone Ministry for Technological Innovation and Digital Transition (held under Draghi by Vittorio Colao) that Meloni abolished. He oversees the Department for Digital Transformation, PNRR digital targets, digital identity (IT Wallet), cloud, AI and broadband.

trade_officials.bio: Adolfo Urso (born 12 July 1957 in Padua), an Italian politician and journalist, is a longtime figure of the Italian right (AN, then Fratelli d'Italia) and served in the Chamber of Deputies (1994-2013). He was Deputy Minister of Economic Development responsible for Foreign Trade in the second and fourth Berlusconi governments. Since 22 October 2022 he has led the renamed Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy, covering industrial policy, business competitiveness, the telecommunications industry and promotion of Italian production, working alongside the Foreign Ministry on exports.

Native title: 'Ministro delle Imprese e del Made in Italy.'

He graduated from Marmara University's Faculty of Economics and Administrative Sciences in international economic relations, becoming associate professor in 2014 and professor in 2019. Before politics he was General Coordinator/CEO of the Albayrak Group for about 23 years and chaired the MÜSİAD business association. As minister he directs export strategy, customs, FTA negotiations and WTO representation, and has led trade talks with the United States.

Türkiye has no separate USTR-equivalent chief trade negotiator; external and domestic trade both fall under this single ministry. In Keir Starmer's September 2025 reshuffle she was appointed Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, succeeding Peter Kyle, taking charge of the UK's digital, technology, science, telecoms and AI-policy portfolio.
